non_software_evaluation.justification: Manual spreadsheets and copy-pasting order details across 150 daily transactions takes over 3 hours daily and introduces 4.2% inventory discrepancy errors. Non-software cannot satisfy sub-hourly stock synchronization.
software_transition_triggers: Stock-out error rate exceeds 1% causing customer cancellations

saas_justification.justification: The core requirement is automated headless synchronization between Shopify webhooks and QuickBooks REST API with an audit trail. A full multi-tenant SaaS UI is not yet justified; a dedicated headless integration service completely solves the problem with 80% less code.

smallest_testable_solution.target_hypothesis: Automating Shopify order paid webhooks directly to QuickBooks via a stateless integration worker eliminates 95% of manual inventory reconciliation time.
smallest_testable_solution.pilot_population: 3 e-commerce store operators with 50-200 daily orders
smallest_testable_solution.success_threshold: Zero inventory stock-out discrepancies and >= 90% reduction in manual reconciliation hours across 14 trial days
smallest_testable_solution.falsification_rule: Frequent API rate limit throttles or complex tax calculation discrepancies requiring manual human intervention on > 5% of orders
smallest_testable_solution.next_step_if_passed: Package worker as a robust, containerized headless integration service with dead-letter queue
smallest_testable_solution.next_step_if_failed: Investigate tax edge cases or fall back to daily batch CSV reconciliation script

technical_operational_profile.state_locality: Transactional database for idempotency keys, OAuth tokens, and audit logs
technical_operational_profile.network_topography: Inbound HTTPS webhook receiver + outbound REST API client with exponential backoff
technical_operational_profile.concurrency_model: Sequential queue per store tenant to prevent inventory race conditions
failure_modes: Webhook signature replay or validation failures
Unmapped SKU variations causing validation rejections
